# Task Board columns show the total value of their visible deals

## Context

A sales team needs to see both the number of deals and the amount at stake in each stage. The planning examples epic identifies this as the missing Engine capability for its sales pipeline example. [Family slate](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21346)

## The Problem

In the Columns example, expanding Archive exposes its three cards. Reordering the columns keeps their count badges. Neither action can show a total for a numeric record field. A workaround that adds the rendered cards will undercount a virtualized column.

## The Architectural Reality

On `78013b10fc`, `src/board/Container.mjs#reconcileColumn` passes the complete filtered status/lane population to `Column#selectWindow` before it allocates card components. `Column#updateHeader` publishes the title, count or WIP badge, collapse control and optional lock. A field-only change takes the card update path in `Container#onStoreRecordChange`, even when no card component exists.

## The Fix

Offer an optional board-wide `columnSummary` config for the sum of one numeric model field. Render its text alongside the existing header. Give applications a formatter for units and currency. Use the existing column membership and store notifications, including changes to offscreen records.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Default | Docs | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Neo.board.Container.columnSummary` | Board store, grouped by the current status/lane and filter | `{field, formatter?}` sums finite numeric values. The formatter receives the sum and returns plain text. An empty column sums to zero. | `null` uses the ordinary header. Without a formatter the total is displayed as a number. | Config JSDoc and Board guide | Real store, sliced and filtered columns, and browser header |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A configured header shows its total alongside its count/WIP. An empty stage displays zero. A board without the config keeps its normal header.
- [ ] A move between stages or lanes updates both headers. Editing the amount updates the owning header even when its card is outside the render window. Filtering, replacing or clearing the store and changing/removing the config all refresh the total.
- [ ] The focused tests exercise the normal Board and Store APIs. A browser walkthrough verifies the visible header changes when a deal moves.

## Out of Scope

The visitor example and its Portal publication follow the example epic's existing process. Further aggregate functions can follow a demonstrated consumer need.
